data.text: When the Hawaiian Islands emerged from the sea as volcanoes, starting about five million years ago, they were far removed from other landmasses.
data.translation: 当夏威夷群岛大约在五百万年前作为火山从海中升起时，它们远离其他大陆块。
data.grammarFocus: 时间状语从句嵌套插入语，主句主语指代。
data.pronounRef: they 指代 the Hawaiian Islands。

sentenceCoach.summary: 先看主句，再看时间背景。
sentenceCoach.keyHint: 注意 they 指的是谁。

teachingFocus.mainQuestion: 这句话告诉我们夏威夷群岛是什么时候、怎么出现的？
teachingFocus.grammarQuestion: When 引导的部分是时间背景，主句才是我们要找的核心事实。
teachingFocus.modifierQuestion: starting about five million years ago 是插入语，补充说明时间起点。
teachingFocus.relationshipQuestion: they 就像一个小标签，贴回了夏威夷群岛上。
teachingFocus.commonMistake: 容易把 When 后面的长句子当成主句，其实主句是 they were far removed...。
thinkingPath: 找到 When 引导的时间背景
找到主句的主语 they 和谓语 were
teachingFocus.encouragement: 你抓住了句子的骨架，真棒！

data.analysis:
### 【主干结构】
主句是 "they were far removed from other landmasses"。主语是 they，系动词是 were，表语是 far removed from other landmasses。

### 【主谓一致】
they 是复数，对应 were，一致。

### 【动词时态与原形】
were 是 be 动词的过去式，描述过去的状态。

### 【从句剖析】
When 引导时间状语从句 "the Hawaiian Islands emerged from the sea as volcanoes"。其中 "starting about five million years ago" 是现在分词短语作插入语，修饰 emerged 的时间起点。

### 【代词指代】
they 指代前半句的主语 the Hawaiian Islands。

segments.label: 状语

data.text: It is significant that the earliest living thing that built communities on these islands are examples of symbiosis, a phenomenon that depends upon the close cooperation of two or more forms of life and a principle that is very important in island communities.

data.logicConnector: that 引导主语从句，that 引导定语从句。

data.analysis:
### 【主干结构】
主句：It is significant。
真正主语：that the earliest living thing... are examples of symbiosis。

### 【主谓一致】
主语从句中，主语是 the earliest living thing (单数)，但谓语是 are (复数)，这里可能是笔误或指代复数概念，或者 living thing 被视作复数集合。根据上下文，living thing 可能指代多种生物，或者此处语法上存在争议，但通常 living thing 单数对应 is。若视为复数概念则用 are。此处按原文 are 解析。

### 【动词时态与原形】
is, built, are, depends, is 等。

### 【从句剖析】
1. that the earliest living thing... are examples of symbiosis 是主语从句。
2. that built communities on these islands 是定语从句，修饰 living thing。
3. a phenomenon that depends... 是 symbiosis 的同位语。
4. that depends upon... 是定语从句，修饰 phenomenon。
5. and a principle that is very important... 是并列的同位语。
6. that is very important... 是定语从句，修饰 principle。

### 【代词指代】
these 指代 the Hawaiian Islands。

teachingFocus.modifierQuestion: when they come... 是时间状语从句。
teachingFocus.relationshipQuestion: 条件有利 -> 外壳变软 -> 存活。
teachingFocus.commonMistake: 容易忽略 Remarkably resistant... 的作用。
thinkingPath: 识别 Remarkably resistant... 为状语
找到主语 they 和谓语 can survive
识别 when 引导的时间状语从句

data.analysis:
### 【主干结构】
主语 they，谓语 can survive。

### 【主谓一致】
they 复数，can survive，一致。

### 【动词时态与原形】
can survive 是情态动词+原形。

### 【从句剖析】
when they come to rest on warm beaches and the conditions are favorable 是时间状语从句。
the seed coats soften 是主句的一部分？不，原文结构稍显复杂，可能是：they can survive prolonged immersion in saltwater [when they come to rest on warm beaches and the conditions are favorable], [and] the seed coats soften. 或者 the seed coats soften 是另一个分句。根据原文逗号，可能是并列句。但更可能是：they can survive... when..., [and] the seed coats soften. 这里假设 the seed coats soften 是伴随结果或并列分句。

### 【代词指代】
they 指代 seeds。
